reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x005127D0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/terrain/005127D0-Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_2.cpp at sha256 771de6e2f0ec1ea6cd4896d1be2be506f7d7ccf6dd49d7c2a45a59542ccdd1a4 (recorded implementation.signature: uint32_t Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_2(void);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_2
retail_function.summary: Five-byte compiler jump thunk 0x005127D0: `jmp Render_ClipMesh_11` to 0x4D95E0; one block, no edges, no locals, no constants.

candidate_function.summary: The candidate defines `j_Render_ClipMesh_11()` with the body `return Render_ClipMesh_11();`, a single tail call to Render_ClipMesh_11.

candidate_comparison.statement: No candidate divergence found in the checked dimensions.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x005127D0 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/terrain/005127D0-Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_2.cpp (sha256 771de6e2f0ec1ea6cd4896d1be2be506f7d7ccf6dd49d7c2a45a59542ccdd1a4). Five-byte compiler jump thunk 0x005127D0: `jmp Render_ClipMesh_11` to 0x4D95E0; one block, no edges, no locals, no constants. Candidate: The candidate defines `j_Render_ClipMesh_11()` with the body `return Render_ClipMesh_11();`, a single tail call to Render_ClipMesh_11.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN models 0x005127D0 as `int32_t()`/`uint32_t()` (no arguments, 32-bit result) and the candidate's `j_Render_ClipMesh_11()` has the same no-argument ABI; the header declares the catalog prototype Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_2(void).

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: No arguments; the tail call forwards the caller's stack and registers unchanged, exactly like the retail jmp.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and radare2 agree on 1 blocks / 0 edges (similarity 1.000); angr CFGFast recovers 1 blocks with has_unresolved_jumps=false.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail's single instruction is the jump to Render_ClipMesh_11 (0x4D95E0); the candidate's single statement is a tail call to Render_ClipMesh_11 at the same address (BN callee table).

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: No stack locals and no global writes in either.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: The jmp forwards Render_ClipMesh_11's 32-bit return value unchanged; `return Render_ClipMesh_11();` returns the same register.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "uint32_t()" at 0x005127D0; radare2 recovers "fcn.005127d0 ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x005127D0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: uint32_t Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_2(void);.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.

The catalog name Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_2 is a harvest label: the retail bytes at 0x005127D0 are a compiler jump thunk to Render_ClipMesh_11 (0x4D95E0), not an implementation of Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_2.

The candidate file defines `j_Render_ClipMesh_11` while its header declares Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_2; the header also does not declare Render_ClipMesh_11. The definition/header names disagree even though the address-bound body matches retail.
The body is a source-level tail call; whether the compiler emits a jmp or a call+ret for it is a build-time question outside this structural review.
